text: Dr Eynon is a university lecturer studying personality. She tested the personality of some of her
students and divided them into two groups, ‘personality R’ and ‘personality S’. Dr Eynon then
showed them photographs of pleasant scenes, such as a beach. Half of the scenes contained
people and half did not contain people. They scored each photograph to show how much they
liked it.

text: Mr Grainger trains each of his farm animals to enter a stable. He lets the animal approach the
stable, then rewards it with food. Each time the animal gets closer to the stable than before, he
rewards it with food. When the animal enters the stable, he rewards it again. He repeats this each
day until the animal enters the stable without rewards.
